## The problem

FEA-06's bind: K13:598 requires "new templates use `withBase()` so
TX-13b's refactor does not grow", but the helper did not exist and
was owned by a ticket (P36.66) landing *after* its first consumers
(P35.36 row 315 statements/provenance, P35.42 row 321 citation
block, every 11C page). Without a containment check, the 85-site
refactor surface G3 NEW-6 measured could only grow between now and
the sweep.

## What landed

- **`web/src/lib/paths.ts`** — `withBase(path)`: joins the
  configured base (`import.meta.env.BASE_URL`; `astro.config.mjs`
  sets no `base` today, so `/`) and the path with exactly one
  separating slash — tolerating leading/trailing slashes, a root
  base, a bare or empty path, and collapsing `//x`-shaped inputs so
  a protocol-relative URL can never smuggle out. `joinBase(base,
  path)` is the exported pure seam (build scripts/tests join
  against an explicit base); `BASE` exposes the configured value
  verbatim. Documented: new templates MUST route root-absolute
  paths through it.
- **`web/scripts/check-root-absolute-paths.mjs`** — the CI
  containment check, wired into the web gate as `check:paths`
  (`npm --prefix web run check` chain, after `check:licenses`,
  before `test:e2e`). It counts root-absolute path sites in
  `web/src/**` (`.astro`/`.ts`/`.tsx`/`.js`/`.jsx`/`.mjs`/`.mts`/
  `.css`; quoted `"/…"`-style literals incl. template-literal
  prefixes, comment-stripped, regex-literal quotes excluded) and
  fails when any file's count exceeds its recorded baseline entry
  or any site lands in a file the baseline does not name. Shrinkage
  passes with an advisory — the baseline may only be lowered (by
  P36.66a's sweep), never raised, without a contract amendment.
  Vacuous = exit 3 (SIG-ENG-042), never a silent green.
- **`web/scripts/root-absolute-paths-baseline.json`** — the
  auditable baseline record (`sig.path-containment-baseline/1`):
  `measured_at` `date -u`, the counting rule verbatim, per-file
  counts, the plan reference, and the allow-list — 8 exempted
  occurrences across 4 files, each with a recorded reason
  (mechanical `"/"` boundary checks in `data.ts`/`map-tiles.ts`/
  `tables.ts`, and `withBase()`'s own internals in `paths.ts` — the
  one construction seam the rule exists to funnel through).
  Re-measured at implement time: **168 raw sites, 160 counted
  across 53 files** (G3's plan-time count was 85/36 — the tree grew
  ~3× between 2026-09-30 and this row; the check now contains
  whatever remains at P36.66a).
- **Tests** — `web/tests/unit/paths.test.ts` (12): root base →
  unchanged path; configured base → joined path; slash edge cases;
  never double slashes; never a protocol-relative escape; the
  `withBase(p) === joinBase(BASE, p)` invariant plus a deliberate
  tripwire that fails when a `base` is configured (whoever sets it
  re-asserts the snapshot shape).
  `web/tests/unit/root-absolute-paths-check.test.ts` (7): a planted
  new root-absolute site fails the check (exit 1), in-file growth
  fails, equality passes, shrinkage passes with the advisory,
  allow-listed constructions pass and fail beyond their cap, the
  real tree holds against the committed baseline, and an empty
  measurement is vacuous (exit 3).
